snippet.title: TetromancerTrailer V1.1
snippet.description: Tetromancer is a puzzle battler where the board is your war economy. Clear lines to conjure an army, then command it in real time against wave after wave of invaders. Stack greedily and you'll field a bigger force, but crowd your board and one bad piece can bury you.
